title: Write a CPlusPlus Plugin
summary: Official Derivative overview for TouchDesigner CPlusPlus plugins, covering plugin class lifecycle, sample-code workflow, platform build/debug paths, custom parameters, Info CHOP/DAT output, Python limitations, and custom-operator reuse.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs C++ plugin lifecycle grounding rather than a single CPlusPlus operator's parameter list.
Each CPlusPlus OP loads a compiled plugin and creates a per-operator class instance; reinit/unload behavior can reset plugin-side state or release a binary file.
Start from Samples/CPlusPlus and the matching base-class header; most detailed API contracts live in the C++ headers and sample comments.
Custom parameters are defined through setupParameters() and pulse actions are handled through pulsePressed(); RGB/RGBA parameter reads should use color-aware accessors when color workflows matter.
Python only works when the plugin is installed as a Custom Operator; it does not work inside a regular CPlusPlus node.
Avoid console printing in performance or shipping contexts because std::cout output has runtime cost.
